name: Lygos
long_description: Performance materials company that used proprietary biology and chemistry to develop sustainable, high-performance ingredients and polymers. The company raised more than $200 million, scaled manufacturing, and commercialized products across agriculture, cleaning, personal care, and other specialty-materials markets. Lygos ultimately concluded through two strategic sales (DOD-funded organization, BioMADE and other strategic acquirers).

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: Eric Steen founded Lygos (YC W16) and spent 15 years building it from a DOE laboratory spinout into a commercial performance-materials company. As CEO, he raised >$200M, built a multidisciplinary org (100+), scaled manufacturing, launched products across multiple markets, and led two strategic sales. Eric holds a BS in Biomedical Engineering from Brown and a PhD in Bioengineering from the joint UC Berkeley–UCSF program, and completed the Management of Technology program at Berkeley Haas.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Jeffrey Dietrich received his Ph.D. in BioEngineering from UC-Berkeley working in Jay Keasling’s lab to develop new biomanufacturing technologies. Jeffrey then co-founded and was CTO at Lygos (YC W16), which raised over $40MM in equity financing and $10MM in Federal awards to commercialize industrial biochemicals. He has also served on advisory boards for Department of Energy- and National Science Foundation-backed institutions and is an inventor on 17 patents or patent applications.
